lede: Jensen Huang's resignation as Nvidia chief executive moved as one story across five separate feeds at once: his Wikipedia page drew 1,072,168 reads, the top Hacker News thread reached 3,273 points, and Lemmy, Polymarket and the AI news wire all carried it. The aftershocks showed up too, with Nvidia CFO Colette Kress climbing to third on Wikipedia and a Polymarket contract opening on who succeeds him. Away from Nvidia, Mastodon spent the morning joking about a Microsoft outage, and the largest of 25 earthquakes, a magnitude 5.8, struck 148 km northwest of Kavieng, Papua New Guinea.

throughlines.title: Jensen Huang
throughlines.gist: Nvidia's longtime chief executive resigned, and the news surfaced at once on Wikipedia, Hacker News, Lemmy, Polymarket and the AI wire, the clearest cross-feed signal of the day.

throughlines.title: Will there be no new be CEO of NVIDIA by December 31, 2028?
throughlines.gist: With the top job suddenly open, Polymarket opened a contract on whether Nvidia will still have no permanent CEO by the end of 2028, echoed by Lemmy's transition announcement.

throughlines.title: bernard tomic
throughlines.gist: Veteran Australian Bernard Tomic drew search traffic after ending a three-year title drought, the same day Polymarket ran a market on his Brisbane match against August Holmgren.
